subject: Buying Virtual Stuff
author: ZombieTron
body:
I still have a really hard time buying anything virtual. I wont be buying anything for my Avatar or any games on demand, I don't buy movies over XBL or MP3's. Call me old fashioned, but if I'm paying good money for it, I like to be able to hold it in my hands! 🙂

Even DLC is a struggle for me, I get extra map packs and other additional gameplay elements that were not developed at the time of the original game being available, but the other little things that they try to sell you which don't add to the gameplay.. I would rather save my money for something a bit more worthwhile.

GamerPics and Premium themes and all of that non-sense are seriously overpriced and not worth it. I like getting the FREE ones tho! 👍

body: Call me crazy, but I like all the stuff that you can buy for your avatar. I've already spend more than 1000 ms points 😳 And I think I will be buying the pom poms after seeing them in action 😛 lol. But yeah the stuff is over priced, but so are most things on xbl.

subject: Avatar Objects
author: ZombieTron
body:
Looking through my friends list yesterday it seems the Purple Pom-Pom's are the most popular item for your Avatar, although some people seem to pull off the cheerleader dance moves better then others!! 🙂 

I'm looking forward to more Avatar games being available, but I think for Guitar Hero 5 to look really cool with Avatars we will need a much bigger variety of FREE Avatar stuff and more variety of looks. Avatars as they are now just don't really ROCK!! 🦇
